raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Opt-in (`VLLM_ROCM_QWEN_FUSED_FULL_ATTN=1`) fused decode for the 16 gated full-attention layers of `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` on MI355X, TP1, `ROCM_ATTN`. Steps of up to 32 rows run each layer from its input RMSNorm through its post-attention RMSNorm as 4 Triton launches instead of 12, with split-KV decode attention. Larger steps run the stock modules.

No open PR covers these layers. #61573 (MXFP4 27B) fuses the GDN and MLP layers and leaves full attention stock; #60833 does the same for the MoE model. #61864 fuses QK-norm + MRoPE + cache write for `ROCM_AITER_FA` via a compile pass. #51406 enables `fused_qk_rmsnorm_rope_gate` on ROCm, which this PR's fallback path calls.

## Claims

- Median TPOT, stock → fused, concurrency 1: −5.4% at 128-token prompts, −39.1% at 4k, −70.6% at 16k (41.05 → 12.08 ms). Concurrency 8: −4.0%, −30.6%, −39.1%. No cell regresses.
- Accuracy unchanged: GSM8K 0.7919 → 0.7873 (mean of 4 runs each, overlapping ranges, standard error ~1.1 pt); passkey retrieval identical at 4k / 16k / 30k.
- Decode launches per step 896 → 768 at batch 1; GPU busy time 12.44 → 11.84 ms.

## Validation

MI355X, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-77154ca6116ae34cbfe314beef1016bde9b63989` with this branch's Python; arms differ only in the env var.

- `pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_qwen_full_attn_decode.py`: 4 passed. Compares the fused launchers against a reference chain (add + RMSNorm, QKV, q/k norm, `get_rope(...).forward_native`, `triton_reshape_and_cache_flash`, `chunked_prefill_paged_decode`, gate, o_proj, add + norm) on the MLP input, residual and full KV-cache buffer. 1 / 4 / 8 / 32 rows with pad rows, block sizes 32 / 48 / 544, padded page stride, contexts 300–8,000, interleaved MRoPE. Then 50 CUDA-graph replays must be bitwise identical (counters reset). Runs in the existing AMD `kernels/attention` job.
- `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` at batch 1 / 8 / 32: no syncs. Prefix caching on (93% of prompt tokens cached): same passkey results on both passes.
- pre-commit passes.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_QWEN_FUSED_FULL_ATTN=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \
    --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 32 --no-enable-prefix-caching --seed 1234
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random \
    --random-input-len 4096 --random-output-len 256 --ignore-eos \
    --num-prompts 32 --max-concurrency 8 --seed 1
python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --port 8000
```

6 runs per cell: seeds 1–3, two rounds, arms on two GPUs at once and swapped between rounds. Prompts per cell: max(16, 4 × concurrency).

| Input / output | Concurrency | Median TPOT (ms) | Output tok/s | Median TTFT (ms) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 128 / 256 | 1 | 11.93 ± 0.02 → 11.29 ± 0.02 (−5.4%) | 80.1 → 86.6 | 72 → 75 |
| 128 / 256 | 8 | 14.84 ± 0.02 → 14.24 ± 0.01 (−4.0%) | 520.7 → 541.5 | 143 → 146 |
| 128 / 256 | 32 | 16.49 ± 0.08 → 16.36 ± 0.01 (−0.8%) | 1811.7 → 1826.0 | 299 → 303 |
| 4096 / 256 | 1 | 19.09 ± 0.01 → 11.63 ± 0.02 (−39.1%) | 49.9 → 79.2 | 261 → 265 |
| 4096 / 256 | 8 | 23.90 ± 0.01 → 16.58 ± 0.57 (−30.6%) | 273.4 → 358.7 | 1390 → 1507 |
| 16384 / 256 | 1 | 41.05 ± 0.01 → 12.08 ± 0.03 (−70.6%) | 22.2 → 61.3 | 1045 → 1056 |
| 16384 / 256 | 8 | 79.33 ± 1.65 → 48.28 ± 0.46 (−39.1%) | 73.6 → 93.3 | 7894 → 9680 |

TTFT: prefill runs stock kernels, 1–4% slower at concurrency 1. At 16k / concurrency 8 the mean rises because decodes finish sooner and more prefills overlap; p99 TTFT is the same (16.3–16.4 s) and the run takes 88 s instead of 111 s.

<details>
<summary>Accuracy</summary>

GSM8K, `gsm8k_eval.py` defaults (5-shot, 1,319 questions, max 256 tokens):

| Arm | Runs | Mean |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stock | 0.7938, 0.7885, 0.7892, 0.7961 | 0.7919 |
| Fused | 0.7877, 0.7854, 0.7870, 0.7892 | 0.7873 |
| Fused, prefix caching on | 0.7862 | |

Passkey: five-digit key at a random depth in filler text, 40 prompts per length, greedy. Stock and fused both 38/40, 40/40, 40/40 at ~4k / 16k / 30k, failing on the same two prompts; 89/120 outputs identical.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Kernel profile and microbenchmarks</summary>

`rocprofv3 --kernel-trace`, batch 1, 128-token prompt, 100 decode steps: launches 896.2 → 768.2, busy 12,438 → 11,837 µs per step. Per layer: `_front_kernel` 32.2 µs, `_attn_kernel` 10.3, `_oproj_kernel` 13.1, `_add_norm_kernel` 4.3.

Layer (input norm through post-attention norm, graph replay): 87.6 → 58.1 µs at 1 row / 300 tokens, 258.0 → 66.1 µs at 1 row / 4k.

Decode attention vs `chunked_prefill_paged_decode` (µs): 1 × 300: 21.9 → 9.8; 1 × 4k: 253.0 → 19.3; 1 × 16k: 742.9 → 29.1; 8 × 16k: 1,315.5 → 124.8; 32 × 4k: 430.7 → 138.1.

</details>

## Details

- At head size 256, `ROCM_ATTN` falls back to `kernel_paged_attention_2d`, one program per (sequence, KV head) with no context split: a single 16k sequence uses 4 of 256 CUs. That is where the long-context gain comes from; at short context it is fewer launches and HBM round trips.
- Three custom ops: `rocm_qwen_full_attn_front` (residual add, input norm, QKV GEMV, q/k norm, (M)RoPE, KV-cache write; 1 launch), `rocm_qwen_full_attn_core` (split-KV attention + sigmoid gate; the `splitting_ops` entry), `rocm_qwen_full_attn_back` (split-K o_proj, add + post norm; 2 launches). The input norm's 1/rms is applied after the GEMV, so the normalized activation is never written.
- Cross-program handoffs use last-arriver counters (release/acquire) that reset themselves, so launches are graph-safe and no program waits.
- Enabled for `Qwen3_5DecoderLayer` full-attention layers with TP1, `ROCM_ATTN`, the output gate, NeoX RoPE (optionally interleaved MRoPE), no quantization, `kv_cache_dtype=auto`, bf16, and supported shapes; otherwise stock. Shapes come from the layer; tiles were tuned on the 27B shapes. Kernels follow their tensors' dtype, so fp16 needs only validation. Quantized weights and fp8 KV stay stock.
- Non-decode steps (prefill, mixed, spec-decode verify) use stock attention inside the same op. Spec decode was not benchmarked.
- About 900 non-test lines, nearly all in the new file. Outside it: the env var, `splitting_ops`, the eligibility check in `qwen3_5.py`, and an early return in `Qwen3NextDecoderLayer.forward` off by default.
- Tried and slower: split-K front GEMV, prefetch in o_proj, `tl.dot` at 1 row, smaller row blocks, blocked attention merge.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. An AI agent (Cursor) wrote the kernels, ran the measurements and drafted this description.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

🚀

Closing this. After comparing against the other ROCm attention backends on MI355X, most of the gain here came from avoiding ROCM_ATTN at head size 256 rather than from the fusion itself:

| Median TPOT (ms), Qwen3.8-27B | ROCM_ATTN | this PR | TRITON_ATTN | ROCM_AITER_FA |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 128 in / c1 | 11.83 | 11.25 | 11.46 | 11.44 |
| 16k in / c1 | 41.06 | 12.06 | 12.52 | 11.87 |
| 16k in / c8 | 79.43 | 47.96 | 32.17 | 27.54 |

A backend-independent version (fused projections only, any attention backend in between) was flat at c1 and 3–7% slower at c8–c32 against the same backend, since the Triton GEMVs trail the stock skinny GEMM. The remaining norm/RoPE/gate fusion is covered by #51406 and #61864, and the backend selection by #62813.

detail.title: [ROCm][Perf][Qwen3.8] Fused decode for the gated full-attention layers of Qwen3.8-27B on MI355X

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,122 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Fused projections around Qwen3.5 gated full attention vs the stock ops."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+    pytest.skip("ROCm-only fused projections", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rocm_qwen_full_attn_decode import (  # noqa: E402
+    fused_back,
+    fused_front,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope  # noqa: E402
+
+# Qwen3.8-27B full-attention layer shapes.
+HID, NQH, NKV, HD, ROT = 5120, 24, 4, 256, 64
+MROPE_SECTION = [11, 11, 10]
+QG = NQH * 2 * HD
+QKV = QG + 2 * NKV * HD
+EPS = 1e-6
+DEV = "cuda"
+BF = torch.bfloat16
+
+
+def _gemma_norm(x, w):
+    xf = x.float()
+    xf = xf * torch.rsqrt(xf.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+    return (xf * (1.0 + w.float())).to(x.dtype)
+
+
+def _add_norm(h, r, w):
+    s = h.float() + r.float()
+    xf = s * torch.rsqrt(s.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+    return (xf * (1.0 + w.float())).to(h.dtype), s.to(h.dtype)
+
+
+def _rel(a, b):
+    return ((a.float() - b.float()).norm() / b.float().norm()).item()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("n,mrope", [(1, False), (5, True), (16, False), (32, True)])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_fused_projections_match_stock(n, mrope):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()):
+        rope = get_rope(
+            head_size=HD,
+            max_position=262144,
+            rope_parameters={
+                "mrope_interleaved": True,
+                "mrope_section": MROPE_SECTION,
+                "partial_rotary_factor": 0.25,
+                "rope_theta": 10000000,
+                "rope_type": "default",
+            },
+            dtype=BF,
+        ).to(DEV)
+    w = {
+        "ln": 0.1 * torch.randn(HID, device=DEV, dtype=BF),
+        "post": 0.1 * torch.randn(HID, device=DEV, dtype=BF),
+        "qn": 0.1 * torch.randn(HD, device=DEV, dtype=BF),
+        "kn": 0.1 * torch.randn(HD, device=DEV, dtype=BF),
+        "qkv": 0.02 * torch.randn(QKV, HID, device=DEV, dtype=BF),
+        "o": 0.02 * torch.randn(HID, NQH * HD, device=DEV, dtype=BF),
+    }
+    pos = torch.randint(0, 20000, (n,), device=DEV)
+    pos3 = pos.expand(3, n).contiguous()
+    if mrope:
+        pos3[1] = (pos3[1] - 7).clamp_min(0)
+        pos3[2] = pos3[2] // 3
+    h = torch.randn(n, HID, device=DEV, dtype=BF)
+    r = 4 * torch.randn(n, HID, device=DEV, dtype=BF)
+    attn = torch.randn(n, NQH * HD, device=DEV, dtype=BF)
+
+    x, r_mid_ref = _add_norm(h, r, w["ln"])
+    qkv = x @ w["qkv"].t()
+    q_gate, k_ref, v_ref = qkv.split([QG, NKV * HD, NKV * HD], dim=-1)
+    q_ref, gate_ref = torch.chunk(q_gate.view(-1, NQH, 2 * HD), 2, dim=-1)
+    q_ref = _gemma_norm(q_ref, w["qn"]).reshape(-1, NQH * HD)
+    gate_ref = gate_ref.reshape(-1, NQH * HD)
+    k_ref = _gemma_norm(k_ref.reshape(-1, NKV, HD), w["kn"]).reshape(-1, NKV * HD)
+    q_ref, k_ref = rope.forward_native(pos3, q_ref, k_ref)
+    gated = attn * torch.sigmoid(gate_ref)
+    x2_ref, r2_ref = _add_norm(gated @ w["o"].t(), r_mid_ref, w["post"])
+
+    cs = rope.cos_sin_cache.to(DEV)
+
+    def run(gate_in):
+        q, gate, k, v, r_mid = fused_front(
+            h, r, pos3, w["ln"], w["qkv"], w["qn"], w["kn"], cs,
+            NQH, NKV, HD, ROT, MROPE_SECTION, EPS,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+        x2, r2 = fused_back(attn, gate_in, r_mid, w["o"], w["post"], EPS)
+        return q, gate, k, v, r_mid, x2, r2
+
+    q, gate, k, v, r_mid, x2, r2 = run(gate_ref)
+    # The fused path rounds intermediates to bf16 at different points.
+    for got, ref in [
+        (r_mid, r_mid_ref),
+        (q, q_ref),
+        (gate, gate_ref),
+        (k, k_ref),
+        (v, v_ref),
+        (x2, x2_ref),
+        (r2, r2_ref),
+    ]:
+        assert _rel(got, ref) < 5e-3
+
+    # Arrival counters must self-reset across HIP-graph replays.
+    g = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(g):
+        outs = run(gate_ref)
+    for _ in range(50):
+        g.replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    for got, ref in zip(outs, (q, gate, k, v, r_mid, x2, r2)):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(got, ref, rtol=0, atol=0)

@@ -156,6 +156,7 @@
     VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS: bool = False
     VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_GEMM: bool = True
     VLLM_ROCM_USE_SKINNY_GEMM: bool = True
+    VLLM_ROCM_QWEN_FUSED_FULL_ATTN: bool = False

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Fused projections around Qwen3.5-family gated full attention on ROCm.
+
+Two custom ops replace the stock chain on either side of the attention
+backend, which runs unchanged in between:
+
+* front: residual add + input RMSNorm + QKV GEMV + q/gate split + q/k
+  RMSNorm + (M)RoPE, in one launch.
+* back: sigmoid output gate + o_proj GEMV, then residual add +
+  post-attention RMSNorm, in two launches.
+
+Steps of at most ``MAX_ROWS`` rows run the fused Triton kernels; larger steps
+run the stock modules inside the same ops.
+
+Front programs hand each q/k head to whichever of them finishes it last
+through an arrival counter, which that program resets, so no program waits
+on another and the counters are back at zero after every launch (HIP-graph
+safe).
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import (
+    LayerNameType,
+    _resolve_layer_name,
+    direct_register_custom_op,
+)
+
+MAX_ROWS = 32
+_O_SPLITS = 4
+# Per padded row count, tuned on MI355X: front (BM, num_warps, num_stages,
+# software-prefetch the next K step), o_proj (BM, num_warps, num_stages).
+_FRONT_CFG = {1: (64, 8, 1, True), 16: (32, 4, 2, False), 32: (64, 4, 2, False)}
+_OPROJ_CFG = {1: (16, 8, 2), 16: (32, 4, 2), 32: (64, 4, 1)}
+
+_FrontOut = tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]
+
+_LAYERS: dict[str, torch.nn.Module] = {}
+_SCRATCH: dict[tuple, torch.Tensor] = {}
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _front_kernel(
+    hid_ptr,
+    res_ptr,
+    res_out_ptr,
+    ln_w_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    qk_scr_ptr,
+    gate_ptr,
+    q_ptr,
+    k_ptr,
+    v_ptr,
+    pos_ptr,
+    cs_ptr,
+    qn_w_ptr,
+    kn_w_ptr,
+    cnt_ptr,
+    n_tok,
+    eps,
+    cs_stride,
+    pos_stride_m,
+    HID: tl.constexpr,
+    NQH: tl.constexpr,
+    NKV: tl.constexpr,
+    HD: tl.constexpr,
+    ROT: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_MROPE: tl.constexpr,
+    MROPE_H: tl.constexpr,
+    MROPE_W: tl.constexpr,
+    NP: tl.constexpr,
+    BM: tl.constexpr,
+    BK: tl.constexpr,
+    RES_CH: tl.constexpr,
+    PREFETCH: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    t = tl.arange(0, NP)
+    tmask = t < n_tok
+    kk = tl.arange(0, BK)
+    QG: tl.constexpr = NQH * 2 * HD
+    KOFF: tl.constexpr = QG + NKV * HD
+    HALF: tl.constexpr = ROT // 2
+    TPH: tl.constexpr = HD // BM
+    SCR: tl.constexpr = (NQH + NKV) * HD
+    KVD: tl.constexpr = NKV * HD
+    dt = q_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+    r0 = pid * BM
+
+    dd = tl.arange(0, HD)
+    partner = tl.where(dd < HALF, dd + HALF, dd - HALF)
+    rmask = tmask[:, None] & (dd < ROT)[None, :]
+    # Epilogue operands are fetched before the weight stream starts.
+    j = dd % HALF
+    pos = tl.load(pos_ptr + t, mask=tmask, other=0).to(tl.int64)[:, None]
+    if HAS_MROPE:
+        pos_h = tl.load(pos_ptr + pos_stride_m + t, mask=tmask, other=0)
+        pos_w = tl.load(pos_ptr + 2 * pos_stride_m + t, mask=tmask, other=0)
+        is_h = ((j % 3 == 1) & (j < 3 * MROPE_H))[None, :]
+        is_w = ((j % 3 == 2) & (j < 3 * MROPE_W))[None, :]
+        pos = tl.where(
+            is_h,
+            pos_h.to(tl.int64)[:, None],
+            tl.where(is_w, pos_w.to(tl.int64)[:, None], pos),
+        )
+    cos = tl.load(cs_ptr + pos * cs_stride + j[None, :], mask=rmask, other=1.0).to(
+        tl.float32
+    )
+    sin = tl.load(
+        cs_ptr + pos * cs_stride + HALF + j[None, :], mask=rmask, other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    nw_ptr = qn_w_ptr if r0 < QG else kn_w_ptr
+    nw = tl.load(nw_ptr + dd).to(tl.float32)
+    nwp = tl.load(nw_ptr + partner).to(tl.float32)
+
+    if pid * RES_CH < HID:
+        c = pid * RES_CH + tl.arange(0, RES_CH)
+        offs = t[:, None] * HID + c[None, :]
+        cm = tmask[:, None] & (c < HID)[None, :]
+        s = tl.load(hid_ptr + offs, mask=cm, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        s += tl.load(res_ptr + offs, mask=cm, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        tl.store(res_out_ptr + offs, s.to(res_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=cm)
+
+    # GEMV on (h + r) * (1 + w); 1/rms is applied to the accumulator.
+    rm = r0 + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    ss_k = tl.zeros([NP, BK], dtype=tl.float32)
+    if NP == 1:
+        acc_k = tl.zeros([BM, BK], dtype=tl.float32)
+    else:
+        acc = tl.zeros([BM, NP], dtype=tl.float32)
+    w_row = w_ptr + rm[:, None].to(tl.int64) * HID + kk[None, :]
+    a_offs = t[:, None] * HID + kk[None, :]
+    if PREFETCH:
+        w_n = tl.load(w_row, cache_modifier=".cg")
+        h_n = tl.load(hid_ptr + a_offs, mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0)
+        r_n = tl.load(res_ptr + a_offs, mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0)
+        lw_n = tl.load(ln_w_ptr + kk)
+    for k0 in range(0, HID, BK):
+        if PREFETCH:
+            w, hh, rr, lw = w_n, h_n, r_n, lw_n
+            if k0 + BK < HID:
+                w_n = tl.load(w_row + k0 + BK, cache_modifier=".cg")
+                h_n = tl.load(
+                    hid_ptr + a_offs + k0 + BK, mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0
+                )
+                r_n = tl.load(
+                    res_ptr + a_offs + k0 + BK, mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0
+                )
+                lw_n = tl.load(ln_w_ptr + k0 + BK + kk)
+        else:
+            w = tl.load(w_row + k0, cache_modifier=".cg")
+            hh = tl.load(hid_ptr + a_offs + k0, mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0)
+            rr = tl.load(res_ptr + a_offs + k0, mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0)
+            lw = tl.load(ln_w_ptr + k0 + kk)
+        s = hh.to(tl.float32) + rr.to(tl.float32)
+        ss_k += s * s
+        a = (s * (1.0 + lw.to(tl.float32)[None, :])).to(w.dtype)
+        if NP == 1:
+            acc_k += w.to(tl.float32) * a.to(tl.float32)
+        else:
+            acc += tl.dot(w, tl.trans(a))
+    if NP == 1:
+        acc = tl.sum(acc_k, axis=1)[:, None]
+    rstd = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(ss_k, axis=1) / HID + eps)
+    out = (acc * rstd[None, :]).to(dt)  # [BM, NP]
+
+    if r0 >= KOFF:
+        d = (r0 - KOFF) + tl.arange(0, BM)
+        tl.store(v_ptr + t[None, :] * KVD + d[:, None], out, mask=tmask[None, :])
+    elif (r0 < QG) and ((r0 % (2 * HD)) >= HD):
+        h = r0 // (2 * HD)
+        d = (r0 % (2 * HD)) - HD + tl.arange(0, BM)
+        tl.store(
+            gate_ptr + t[None, :] * (NQH * HD) + h * HD + d[:, None],
+            out,
+            mask=tmask[None, :],
+        )
+    else:
+        if r0 < QG:
+            head = r0 // (2 * HD)
+            d0 = r0 % (2 * HD)
+        else:
+            head = NQH + (r0 - QG) // HD
+            d0 = (r0 - QG) % HD
+        d = d0 + tl.arange(0, BM)
+        tl.store(
+            qk_scr_ptr + t[None, :] * SCR + head * HD + d[:, None],
+            out,
+            mask=tmask[None, :],
+        )
+        tl.debug_barrier()
+        old = tl.atomic_add(cnt_ptr + head, 1, sem="release", scope="gpu")
+        if old == TPH - 1:
+            tl.atomic_xchg(cnt_ptr + head, 0, sem="acquire", scope="gpu")
+            base = qk_scr_ptr + t[:, None] * SCR + head * HD
+            v = tl.load(base + dd[None, :], mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0).to(
+                tl.float32
+            )
+            vp = tl.load(base + partner[None, :], mask=rmask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+            r = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(v * v, axis=1) / HD + eps)[:, None]
+            vx = (v * r * (1.0 + nw[None, :])).to(dt).to(tl.float32)
+            vp = (vp * r * (1.0 + nwp[None, :])).to(dt).to(tl.float32)
+            sign = tl.where(dd < HALF, -1.0, 1.0)
+            rot = vx * cos + sign[None, :] * vp * sin
+            res = tl.where((dd < ROT)[None, :], rot, vx).to(dt)
+            if head < NQH:
+                dst = q_ptr + t[:, None] * (NQH * HD) + head * HD + dd[None, :]
+            else:
+                dst = k_ptr + t[:, None] * KVD + (head - NQH) * HD + dd[None, :]
+            tl.store(dst, res, mask=tmask[:, None])
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _oproj_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    gate_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    h_ptr,
+    n_tok,
+    HID: tl.constexpr,
+    KIN: tl.constexpr,
+    NP: tl.constexpr,
+    BM: tl.constexpr,
+    BK: tl.constexpr,
+    SK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    ks = tl.program_id(1)
+    t = tl.arange(0, NP)
+    tmask = t < n_tok
+    kk = tl.arange(0, BK)
+    rm = pid * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    if NP == 1:
+        acc_k = tl.zeros([BM, BK], dtype=tl.float32)
+    else:
+        acc = tl.zeros([BM, NP], dtype=tl.float32)
+    KC: tl.constexpr = KIN // SK
+    w_row = w_ptr + rm[:, None].to(tl.int64) * KIN + kk[None, :]
+    x_offs = t[:, None] * KIN + kk[None, :]
+    for k0 in range(ks * KC, ks * KC + KC, BK):
+        w = tl.load(w_row + k0, cache_modifier=".cg")
+        x = tl.load(x_ptr + x_offs + k0, mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0)
+        g = tl.load(gate_ptr + x_offs + k0, mask=tmask[:, None], other=0.0)
+        xg = (x.to(tl.float32) * tl.sigmoid(g.to(tl.float32))).to(w.dtype)
+        if NP == 1:
+            acc_k += w.to(tl.float32) * xg.to(tl.float32)
+        else:
+            acc += tl.dot(w, tl.trans(xg))
+    if NP == 1:
+        acc = tl.sum(acc_k, axis=1)[:, None]
+    tl.store(
+        h_ptr + (ks * NP + t[None, :]) * HID + rm[:, None],
+        acc,
+        mask=tmask[None, :],
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _add_norm_kernel(
+    h_ptr,
+    res_ptr,
+    x_out_ptr,
+    res_out_ptr,
+    ln_w_ptr,
+    eps,
+    HID: tl.constexpr,
+    NP: tl.constexpr,
+    SK: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    c = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    cmask = c < HID
+    offs = row * HID + c
+    o = tl.zeros([BLOCK], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for ks in tl.static_range(SK):
+        o += tl.load(h_ptr + (ks * NP + row) * HID + c, mask=cmask, other=0.0)
+    s = o.to(x_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    s += tl.load(res_ptr + offs, mask=cmask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(res_out_ptr + offs, s.to(res_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=cmask)
+    rstd = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(s * s, axis=0) / HID + eps)
+    lw = tl.load(ln_w_ptr + c, mask=cmask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    y = s * rstd * (1.0 + lw)
+    tl.store(x_out_ptr + offs, y.to(x_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=cmask)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _sigmoid_gate_kernel(x_ptr, gate_ptr, out_ptr, numel, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    offs = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < numel
+    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offs, mask=mask).to(tl.float32)
+    g = tl.load(gate_ptr + offs, mask=mask).to(tl.float32)
+    o = x * tl.sigmoid(g)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + offs, o.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+
+
+def _scratch(
+    name: str, numel: int, dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Persistent per-process buffer; counters start (and stay) at zero."""
+    key = (name, numel, dtype, device)
+    buf = _SCRATCH.get(key)
+    if buf is None:
+        buf = torch.zeros(numel, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+        _SCRATCH[key] = buf
+    return buf
+
+
+def _padded_rows(n: int) -> int:
+    # 1 row uses an FMA mainloop, 16/32 use tl.dot.
+    return 1 if n == 1 else (16 if n <= 16 else 32)
+
+
+def fused_front(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    in_ln_w: torch.Tensor,
+    qkv_w: torch.Tensor,
+    q_norm_w: torch.Tensor,
+    k_norm_w: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    rotary_dim: int,
+    mrope_section: list[int] | None,
+    eps: float,
+) -> _FrontOut:
+    """Returns (q, gate, k, v, residual + hidden).
+
+    ``positions`` is [n] or [3, n]; the latter with ``mrope_section`` applies
+    interleaved MRoPE.
+    """
+    n, hid = hidden.shape
+    np_ = _padded_rows(n)
+    nqk = (num_heads + num_kv_heads) * head_dim
+    qk_scr = _scratch("qk", MAX_ROWS * nqk, hidden.dtype, hidden.device)
+    cnt = _scratch("front_cnt", num_heads + num_kv_heads, torch.int32, hidden.device)
+    has_mrope, mrope_h, mrope_w = False, 0, 0
+    if positions.ndim == 2:
+        if mrope_section:
+            has_mrope, mrope_h, mrope_w = True, mrope_section[1], mrope_section[2]
+        else:
+            positions = positions[0]
+
+    res_mid = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    q = hidden.new_empty(n, num_heads * head_dim)
+    gate = torch.empty_like(q)
+    k = hidden.new_empty(n, num_kv_heads * head_dim)
+    v = torch.empty_like(k)
+    bm, warps, stages, prefetch = _FRONT_CFG[np_]
+    grid = qkv_w.shape[0] // bm
+    _front_kernel[(grid,)](
+        hidden, residual, res_mid, in_ln_w, qkv_w, qk_scr, gate, q, k, v,
+        positions, cos_sin_cache, q_norm_w, k_norm_w, cnt, n, eps,
+        cos_sin_cache.stride(0), positions.stride(0) if has_mrope else 0,
+        HID=hid, NQH=num_heads, NKV=num_kv_heads, HD=head_dim, ROT=rotary_dim,
+        HAS_MROPE=has_mrope, MROPE_H=mrope_h, MROPE_W=mrope_w, NP=np_, BM=bm,
+        BK=256, RES_CH=triton.next_power_of_2(triton.cdiv(hid, grid)),
+        PREFETCH=prefetch, num_warps=warps, num_stages=stages,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    return q, gate, k, v, res_mid
+
+
+def fused_back(
+    attn: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    res_mid: torch.Tensor,
+    o_w: torch.Tensor,
+    post_ln_w: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Returns (post_norm(h + res_mid), h + res_mid) for
+    h = o_proj(attn * sigmoid(gate))."""
+    n = attn.shape[0]
+    hid = o_w.shape[0]
+    np_ = _padded_rows(n)
+    h = _scratch("o", _O_SPLITS * MAX_ROWS * hid, torch.float32, attn.device)
+    bm, warps, stages = _OPROJ_CFG[np_]
+    _oproj_kernel[(hid // bm, _O_SPLITS)](
+        attn, gate, o_w, h, n,
+        HID=hid, KIN=o_w.shape[1], NP=np_, BM=bm, BK=256, SK=_O_SPLITS,
+        num_warps=warps, num_stages=stages,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    x_out, res_out = torch.empty_like(res_mid), torch.empty_like(res_mid)
+    _add_norm_kernel[(n,)](
+        h, res_mid, x_out, res_out, post_ln_w, eps,
+        HID=hid, NP=np_, SK=_O_SPLITS, BLOCK=triton.next_power_of_2(hid),
+        num_warps=8,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    return x_out, res_out
+
+
+def _add_norm(
+    h: torch.Tensor, res: torch.Tensor, w: torch.Tensor, eps: float
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    hid = h.shape[1]
+    x_out, res_out = torch.empty_like(h), torch.empty_like(res)
+    _add_norm_kernel[(h.shape[0],)](
+        h, res, x_out, res_out, w, eps,
+        HID=hid, NP=1, SK=1, BLOCK=triton.next_power_of_2(hid), num_warps=8,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    return x_out, res_out
+
+
+def supports_fused_full_attn_decode(
+    hidden_size: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    rotary_dim: int,
+) -> bool:
+    min_bm = min(cfg[0] for cfg in _FRONT_CFG.values())
+    max_bm = max(cfg[0] for cfg in _FRONT_CFG.values())
+    qkv_rows = 2 * (num_heads + num_kv_heads) * head_dim
+    return (
+        head_dim == triton.next_power_of_2(head_dim)
+        and head_dim % max_bm == 0
+        and hidden_size % 256 == 0
+        and qkv_rows % min_bm == 0
+        and (num_heads * head_dim) % (256 * _O_SPLITS) == 0
+        and rotary_dim % 2 == 0
+        and rotary_dim <= head_dim
+    )
+
+
+def register_layer(layer_name: str, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    _LAYERS[layer_name] = layer
+
+
+def rocm_qwen_full_attn_front(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    q_size: int,
+    kv_size: int,
+    layer_name: LayerNameType,
+) -> _FrontOut:
+    layer = _LAYERS[_resolve_layer_name(layer_name)]
+    sa = layer.self_attn
+    eps = layer.input_layernorm.variance_epsilon
+    n = hidden_states.shape[0]
+    if n <= MAX_ROWS:
+        return fused_front(
+            hidden_states, residual, positions[..., :n],
+            layer.input_layernorm.weight, sa.qkv_proj.weight, sa.q_norm.weight,
+            sa.k_norm.weight, sa.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache, sa.num_heads,
+            sa.num_kv_heads, sa.head_dim, sa.rotary_emb.rotary_dim,
+            getattr(sa.rotary_emb, "mrope_section", None), eps,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+    x, res_mid = _add_norm(hidden_states, residual, layer.input_layernorm.weight, eps)
+    qkv, _ = sa.qkv_proj(x)
+    q, k, v, gate = sa._project_qkv_gate(qkv, positions)
+    return q, gate, k.contiguous(), v.contiguous(), res_mid
+
+
+def _front_fake(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    q_size: int,
+    kv_size: int,
+    layer_name: LayerNameType,
+) -> _FrontOut:

+    return torch.empty_like(res_mid), torch.empty_like(res_mid)

🚀

Closing this. After comparing against the other ROCm attention backends on MI355X, most of the gain here came from avoiding ROCM_ATTN at head size 256 rather than from the fusion itself:

| Median TPOT (ms), Qwen3.8-27B | ROCM_ATTN | this PR | TRITON_ATTN | ROCM_AITER_FA |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 128 in / c1 | 11.83 | 11.25 | 11.46 | 11.44 |
| 16k in / c1 | 41.06 | 12.06 | 12.52 | 11.87 |
| 16k in / c8 | 79.43 | 47.96 | 32.17 | 27.54 |

A backend-independent version (fused projections only, any attention backend in between) was flat at c1 and 3–7% slower at c8–c32 against the same backend, since the Triton GEMVs trail the stock skinny GEMM. The remaining norm/RoPE/gate fusion is covered by #51406 and #61864, and the backend selection by #62813.
